task.title: Build immutable discovered extension registry snapshots
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/602 by owning one all-or-nothing discovery result behind deterministic enumeration and exact-ID lookup.
acceptance_criteria: Construct a registry only after complete successful descriptor-anchored discovery.
Resolve exact caller-authored IDs without normalization, authorization, or activation.
Enumerate borrowed entries in manifest-path order rather than ID order.
Keep snapshots immutable and require explicit rediscovery to observe filesystem changes.

attempts.summary: Established RED for immutable registry ownership.
attempts.diagnostic: Discovery returned a vector but exposed no explicit snapshot owner, stable exact-ID lookup, or refresh semantics.
attempts.patch: Added tests for exact lookup, path-ordered enumeration, empty roots, unchanged discovery errors, and immutability across later filesystem changes.

attempts.summary: Implemented the smallest non-activating registry snapshot.
attempts.diagnostic: Owning the discovered vector plus an ID-to-index map separates deterministic discovery order from identity lookup without adding mutable lifecycle policy.
attempts.patch: Added ExtensionRegistry::discover, get, extensions, snapshot documentation, and README milestone evidence.

attempts.summary: Resolved a documentation contradiction found by substantive review.
attempts.diagnostic: The initial non-goals still excluded all registries even though the same document now specified a single-root immutable registry.
attempts.patch: Narrowed the non-goal to mutable registries and verified the corrected exact head before merge.

outcome.summary: Vela now owns immutable, explicit-refresh extension registry snapshots with exact-ID lookup and deterministic path-order inspection, while activation remains outside the boundary.

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/actions/runs/30178028631 and substantive incremental CodeRabbit review at https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/pull/603

lessons: Registry ownership can be introduced independently of capability activation and lifecycle policy.
Identity lookup order and deterministic inspection order are distinct contracts and should remain separate.
Immutable snapshots make filesystem refresh explicit and auditable.
Documentation non-goals must be revised when a previously excluded boundary becomes implemented.
